# LAB only: PR #141 UTC SD timestamp and SD hot-removal one-way fault latch.
# Tested head b83ecb03ece5e03a4b47812ee8a8b23840437afc
# Standard 2.8 ST7789 + 3.2 ST7798; 80MHz variants compiled as usual.
# On SD file open or short write error: stop logging and clear the pending buffer,
# avoiding repeated synchronous SPI timeouts that lag the scan/UI loop.
# No automatic reinsertion: reboot with card installed to restart logging.
# Video of the original failure is pending from hardware tester.
# No PR merge, public production release, version tag, or branch deletion.
